candidates.title: A handoff that separates a changed mount from a changed measurement
candidates.uncertainty: The published graded score gives no probability that a particular mating surface fits or that its dimensions survive an edit.
candidates.action: Have the outgoing team ship the editable docking drawing, three named contact dimensions and their tolerances. Let the recipient change its bench offset and regenerate a digital witness of alignment before using bench time.
candidates.test: On withheld adapter drawings independently measure the contact geometry before and after the offset edit. Record false acceptance and correction time against the designer's native parametric template.
candidates.alternative: A conventional CAD template and a dimensioned inspection drawing supplied by the outgoing team.

candidates.title: Reserve the instrument for the team that can still use the weather window
candidates.uncertainty: A directly initialized forecast can be available before a full analysis, but local skill, issue-time availability and teams' willingness to swap places are unknown.
candidates.action: Prepare a reversible dispatch rule that pairs a weather-sensitive observing team with an indoor metrology standby. Use the forecast actually knowable before packing time to recommend whether to move the instrument.
candidates.test: On held-out transfers replay timestamped forecasts and station observations. Compare completed useful sessions, wasted transfers and standby disruptions against ordinary published forecasts and the fixed rota, using identical forecast issue deadlines.
candidates.alternative: Use existing forecasts, a conventional standby list and the operator's normal release deadline.

candidates.title: A transferable receipt for the reduction model used at the previous bench
candidates.uncertainty: The reported proving rate is specific to a model, stage and hardware. A verified computation alone cannot establish calibration of the physical sensor.
candidates.action: Package a public reference exposure with the committed reduction-model identity and a verifiable record of a prior inference. Let a receiving lab qualify that digital stage separately before deciding whether a physical reference exposure must be repeated.
candidates.test: Using a genuine public proof, independently verify the committed computation, reject a mismatched input and measure total handoff time versus re-running accessible reference weights. Report physical validation separately.
candidates.alternative: Distribute the reference input, weights and deterministic runtime and have each recipient rerun them.

candidates.title: A night-shift rehearsal with real alerts and quietly withheld misses
candidates.uncertainty: Recovery of known active objects does not measure false positives, availability of the instrument, or the completeness of the eligible sky population.
candidates.action: Use a frozen broker stream to hand the optical instrument's incoming team a timed dispatch rehearsal. Keep the declared reference objects separate from the broker's output so the handoff exposes missed opportunities as well as successful routing.
candidates.test: Replay a later held-out night under the information available at each alert. Have an independent scheduler score feasible visits, known missed labels and occupied slots against the facility's existing broker filter.
candidates.alternative: A broker filter with a human observer and a conventional scheduling worksheet.

candidates.title: Carry acceptance tests between host computers instead of copying an old binary
candidates.uncertainty: A published parallel evaluator does not establish that candidate search beats the existing library, or that cloud execution is available to the facility.
candidates.action: For the instrument's reduction step, retain invariant tests and a representative public workload at handoff. Evaluate candidate implementations for correctness and full-pipeline time on the receiving host, using ordinary local processes under the same resource limit.
candidates.test: Withhold a host configuration and a class of inputs. Reject accuracy drift, include search and verification time, and compute the observed run count required to recover setup versus a tuned stock library.
candidates.alternative: Install the existing optimized library and run the same acceptance and timing suite once.
